description: This file defines the MBField class, which models a field in the SuiteCRM Module Builder. It includes properties for field attributes and methods to generate variable definitions based on field properties.

classes.name: MBField
classes.description: A class representing a field in the SuiteCRM Module Builder, capable of producing variable definitions for the field based on properties such as type, default, options, etc.

methods.name: getFieldVardef
methods.description: Generates and returns an array defining the field's attributes for use in SuiteCRM, or returns false if the 'name' property is not set.

methods.name: addDropDown
methods.description: Returns the options for an enum-type dropdown, defaulting to the 'options' property.

methods.name: addLabel
methods.description: Returns the label vname for the field, typically used for localization.
